steps.comment: ITEM 1: the stores book says what is on the crag by arithmetic, the crag has it, and Ott renders it down. Nothing anywhere says what it is.
The ledger stands on the drawing office bookshelf, which is solid: walking into it turns Bram to face it and the action button does the rest.

steps.label: the stores book: issued 199 times, returned 198
the crag is at the end of a track the works keeps cut
in through the rent, which is the only thing broken on her
one crate, stencilled on all six faces, and two of you carry it
ITEM 1 is off the crag for the first time since 1802
and what is left is four straps and a set of chocks
the crate in the party beats every other page Ott has
and takes the fuse out of it first, before anything else is touched
the rest comes back from Ollerenshaw's as eighteen pounds on a shaft
and with the crate gone she drops back to the last rung of the ladder, which is what she says for the rest of the game - nothing in this scenario ever asked her for an airship
